watch.en: Items are sometimes dusted with flour before they go into the batter.
watch.de: Manchmal wird das Gargut vor dem Eintauchen in den Backteig mit Mehl bestäubt.

why.en: A batter coating is smoother than breading and absorbs less oil. It stands between the food and the oil and dries into the crisp crust.
why.de: Ein Teigmantel ist glatter als Panade und nimmt weniger Öl auf. Er steht zwischen Gargut und Öl und trocknet zur knusprigen Kruste.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 8.1 Frying Methods, section Batters and Breading
sources.sentence: Items are sometimes dusted in flour before being battered.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 8.1 Frying Methods, section Batters and Breading
sources.sentence: Batter coatings are smoother and have less surface area than most breaded coatings, so they tend to absorb less cooking oil.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter Meat, Breadings and Batters, p. 162
sources.sentence: These coatings do not “seal in” moisture.
